newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron eyes export of asphalt to China.
newsitem.headline: Petron eyes export of asphalt to China.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp said on Monday it was negotiating with Singapore Petroleum Co to ferry asphalt to China.

"We expect to export 1,000 barrels daily and hope to come come to an agreement with Singapore Petroleum to lift our asphalt to China," Petron president Ali Al-Ajmi told reporters after the stockholders' meeting.
Al-Ajmi said the company is setting up asphalt export facilities at its refinery in Bataan, north of Manila, for completion before the end of the year.
Asphalt is a by-product of the crude refining process.
Petron exported 14,000 bpd of surplus products, mostly naphtha, in 1996. Petron said there is a growing demand for asphalt in the international market, notably China.
